body:
Hello, my name is paul and I have a company called lightbulbstogo. I'm interestedin your LED lightbulb products as I think it would be a good fit for my customers here in france. Please could we arrange to meet to discuss the potential export/import process and to discuss the possibility of a bulk discount?

Kind Regards,

Paul Tennent
Lightbulbstogo limited
Paris
France
reply:
Dear Paul,

Thank you for your message. I would be happy to discuss the potential export/import process for our LED lightbulb products as well as the possibility of a bulk discount.

Could you please provide your availability for a meeting? I look forward to your reply.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
